coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official municipal bureau and city registration-center materials evidence Heze local registration custody and cadastral-map use in registration workflows.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public parcel layer, feature-service schema, CRS, native parcel identity, or bounded geometry response was verified. Exact-point and citywide parcel coverage remain unknown.

technicalBlocker: The official portal is a news/procedure site whose current JavaScript exposes only article/category services. The HTTPS host failed normal certificate validation, and no TLS exception was authorized; the HTTP copy was used only to inspect public HTML/configuration.
remainingUncertainty: Whether Heze has a separate authenticated or non-indexed public cadastral viewer, and whether any city or county parcel service is exposed through Shandong’s mapping platform, remains unresolved.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may inspect a documented first-party feature service if one is publicly exposed, first confirming schema, CRS, native identity, and safe fields.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
